decision.what: Two small local fixes for the ai2 hang, found from a CDP CPU profile
decision.chose: (1) groups.js: memoize Groups.members(gid) keyed by a _rev counter bumped in changed() — before, one paint() call recomputed it 6-8x per group (inside ordered()'s sort, latest(), the size count, cost(), and the at_of loop), and the profile's top groups.js entries (at(), its index array, card_words()) all trace back to that. (2) live.js: place()'s call to wide() forces a synchronous getComputedStyle layout read; it ran on every redraw of the Live card (the page's own default view), which was the single biggest self-time entry in the whole profile (748.9ms). Now only the card's own ResizeObserver (a real resize) remeasures; an ordinary redraw reuses the cached answer.
decision.alternative: Rewriting card_page()'s draw() to dedupe the Live item's signature before a full DOM rebuild — bigger, touches more of page.js, left as a later idea in profile.md instead.
